reason: We have no car right now, so getting to Jbeil for a shop is a real hassle, and a $2 fee for someone to buy it and have it in my village is less than a taxi or asking a favour. I'd try it for stock-up lists, not every day.
objection: How do I know they really paid the cheap price and didn't add a markup? Nothing here says I'd see the receipt, and I only trust a deal if I can check it against Tawfeer's own offers.
would_change_my_mind: A photo of the till receipt with every bag, so I can check each item price against the Tawfeer offers I already follow.
